title: Smart Language Agents in Real-World Planning

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.1: "We decided to use GPT-4 Turbo as the base travel-planning agent model due to its high performance... its easy accessibility through its API."; Table 1 row "GPT-4 Turbo Baseline" Final Pass Rate 5.55.

prompt.location: Sec 4.3 ("we used their zero-shot prompt, with unstructured reference data" - TravelPlanner's own published prompt, cited via GitHub, not reprinted in this paper)
prompt.note: The paper's own 'Manually Modified' and 'GPT-4o Generated' prompts are described only qualitatively and are not reconstructable from the text.

claim.metric: Final Pass Rate, TravelPlanner sole-planning (zero-shot baseline)
claim.location: Table 1, row 'GPT-4 Turbo Baseline' (TravelPlanner validation split)

data.source: TravelPlanner benchmark (Xie et al. 2024); authors' fork at github.com/llv22/TravelPlanner_forward

notes: This baseline number is essentially a re-run of TravelPlanner's own published zero-shot GPT-4-Turbo result, using their public eval scripts. The paper's actual contribution (human-in-the-loop refined prompt, final pass rate up to 12.78) is not reproducible since its exact prompt content is only described qualitatively. GPT-4o is used separately, only to auto-generate prompt rules, not as the plan-generation agent.
